maddeler.e:
تقابلت (form VI)
# تَقَابَلْتُ (taqābaltu) /ta.qaː.bal.tu/: first-person singular past active of تَقَابَلَ (taqābala)
# تَقَابَلْتَ (taqābalta) /ta.qaː.bal.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of تَقَابَلَ (taqābala)
# تَقَابَلْتِ (taqābalti) /ta.qaː.bal.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of تَقَابَلَ (taqābala)
# تَقَابَلَتْ (taqābalat) /ta.qaː.ba.lat/: third-person fem
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
